package.name: social_nav_rl
package.description: Experimental reinforcement-learning social navigation policy. Consumes the existing human tracking + classical prediction as a fixed-size observation, learns a continuous local command, and runs behind a safety supervisor. The learning stack (gymnasium, stable-baselines3, torch) is an optional pip dependency used only for training/eval; the observation/reward/safety/action core is pure and needs neither ROS nor a GPU.
